fileEquipment-clip.label: Clip
fileEquipment-clip.tip:
Clip area of icon
$Related command
Load Image

fileEquipment-inherit.label: Inherit
fileEquipment-inherit.tip:
Inherits specified equipment's attributes, events, and scripts
If the same attribute exists, it overrides the inherited equipment's attribute value
If the same type of event exists, it overrides the inherited equipment's event
Overridden events can still be triggered using the 'Call Event' command
However, inherited scripts will stack instead of being overridden

fileEquipment-attributes.label: Attributes
fileEquipment-attributes.tip:
Initial attribute list
$Optional types
Boolean, Number, String, Enumeration(String)
$Related commands
Set Boolean, Set Number, Set String

fileEquipment-events.label: Events
fileEquipment-events.tip:
A list of equipment events
Access "Event Trigger Actor" to get the actor with this equipment
Access "Event Trigger Equipment" to get this equipment
$Optional types
Create: Triggered at equipment initialization (once)
Add Equipment: Triggered when the actor adds this equipment
Remove Equipment: Triggered when the actor removes this equipment
Custom: Triggered by the "Call Event" command

fileEquipment-scripts.label: Scripts
fileEquipment-scripts.tip: Add script files to extend this equipment
